question.en: Draw a sequence diagram to describe the process for generating the salary list in a company. The company has departments with employees. Each department has one head. For each department take the list of employees and print the amount to be paid as a salary. First, print the salary information about the head of the department. At the end, print the total amount of salary to be paid in the department.

question.en: Draw a sequence diagram to model the ordering section of a company. Based on the received proforma invoice, an order should be created. The products listed in the proforma invoice are added to the order, whereby it should be checked if they are in stock. If they are in stock, then the appropriate quantity of the products is taken from the warehouse and confirmation is sent. After that, the remaining products are checked. When the order is completed, a message FINISHED is returned.
